Applies force to a material specimen in order to measure the material’s response to tensile (or pulling) stress

Torsion Testing

 6800 Series Table Model System — 3D & Augmented Reality Viewer
 6800 Series Table Model System — 3D & Augmented Reality Viewer
Explore the 6800 Series table model system in 3D, or use your mobile device to place it in your own lab space with augmented reality. Scan the QR code with your phone to launch the AR experience, or click below to open the 3D viewer.
Augmented reality requires a supported mobile device and browser.

The Instron supplied high performance PC is specifically designed for use with Dynamic and Fatigue testing systems.
